requestedIntent: Reduce repeated ACEF execution and state-reconciliation work while preserving authentic evidence, independent review, versioned lifecycle obligations, and truthful execution accounting.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Evidence reuse and lightweight state now have explicit integrity boundaries

limitations: Source enforcement and 21 focused/compatibility suites, including disposable installed fixtures, were verified locally on 2026-09-11; this is not a target-project rollout.
No target project has been updated by this source change, and no production deployment or cost-savings percentage is claimed.
Runner proofs and state receipts are local integrity checks, not cryptographic signatures against an actor with unrestricted repository write access.
Automatic reuse is limited to the explicit syntax-only Node input/toolchain contract; arbitrary lint/typecheck scripts and external-service/database execution are not cached.
Ordered publication is recoverable but not multi-file crash atomic; unexpected edits block recovery without being overwritten.

evidence.note: Pending and malformed receipts block authorization and next/status packets, including Direct fallback; actor and evidence mutations leave no side effects.
Actual syntax-only reuse, changed inputs, excluded configuration, unsafe commands, and legacy evidence are covered; aliases do not create physical attempts.
Initial-read preconditions, interrupted publication, later-destination edits during recovery, and dead locks without journals are covered.

Real PASS/non-PASS closure, authentic fixture recovery, exact staged dependencies, control-only terminal commit followed by objective closure, product drift, same-run scope preservation, and new-run isolation pass.

Nine validated successful runs remain admissible; invalid review artifacts, proof tampering, no-progress/replan limits, and unresolved non-PASS outcomes are rejected. Explicit objective CLI mutation tests also pass.
Unknown/malformed records, inconsistent IDs/status/times, altered recovery receipts, and repeated cross-mode recovery fail closed.
Two declared surfaces consume one immutable evidence source; lifecycle validation passes without executing the source command again.
Legacy Full six-actor-v2 retains v1 objective semantics; broad state, typed-state, lifecycle, Quick Fix, and process-validator compatibility suites pass.
Installed command/helper/schema packaging passes. The final installer/compatibility run retained source runtime digest 1e36881f427ef228aa7b80cc9805393a11c74613459072d48a30344a6004953e.
